STAFF OF THE BOARD: (1) The    Minister    shall    in  consultation  with  the

column1: Council appiont a person who is suitably  qualified in the
field  of  Science and Technology to be the Director  of the
Board (in this Act referred to as "the Director" ).

STAFF OF THE BOARD: The  terms  and  conditions  of  employment  of  the

column1: Director  shall be determined by the Minister.

STAFF OF THE BOARD: The  remuneration  of  the  Director  shall  be

column1: determined  by  the  Minister  with  the  concurrence  of  the
Minister in charge of the subject of Finance.

STAFF OF THE BOARD: Whenever the Director  is by reason of illness  or

column1: absence from  Sri  Lanka or for any other cause,  unable to
perform the duties of  his office, the Minister may appoint
another person to act in his place, during  such absence.

STAFF OF THE BOARD: The functions of the Director, who shall be the Chief

column1: Executive  Officer  of  the  Board,  shall  be  to  organize,  and
direct the work of the Board under the directions of and in
accordance with the policies adopted by the Council and he
shall function as the Secretary to the Council.
